description: Huawei Cloud EIP (Elastic Public IP) query and bandwidth monitoring skill using hcloud CLI (KooCLI). Supports listing Elastic Public IPs, viewing EIP details, and querying Cloud Eye (CES) bandwidth monitoring data for EIPs: bandwidth usage rate (%), inbound/outbound traffic (Byte), peak/avg bandwidth (bit/s), across a configurable time range with aggregation period. Use when users need to query EIP resources, check EIP bandwidth utilization, analyze inbound/outbound traffic, monitor bandwidth peaks/averages, or troubleshoot EIP bandwidth issues. Triggers: "EIP query", "EIP list", "弹性公网IP查询", "EIP带宽监控", "带宽使用率", "流入流量", "流出流量", "带宽峰值", "带宽均值", "EIP监控", "带宽监控", "EIP bandwidth", "traffic monitoring", "CES metrics", "Cloud Eye metrics"
